tables.title: Curio rules
rows: Fate Spirals come from the daily upgrade, chests at 80 gems each (unverified until checked in game), achievements, logins, the Hourglass shop (a Curio for Gold-rift gold, 100 rising x1.3 over 10 purchases, about 4,260 gold) and the paid Curio Pack (an extra daily roll). For the choice each roll offers, see Curio 'Daily Fate Spiral'; for the upgrade purchase, see Gems tier 3.
21 inventory slots hold all 20 curios plus a spare.
Active curios earn coins up to a cap, so collect often. Coins level curios; salvaging unwanted curios gives more.
One duplicate raises a curio's ascension level by one, adding passives.

Since the Harvest Event update (12 November 2026) you can wish for one Legendary curio: if a Legendary drop misses it, the next Legendary is the wished one. Spare Legendaries trade back for rolls, and chests can auto-open until a chosen rarity drops.

Curio and rune layouts can be saved as presets (six pages each) that switch with your activity. Pages are account-wide, but which page an activity uses is set per character; presets replace the old snapshotting trick. Unlocks at combat level 70.
Match the active set to what you are doing: crit curios for pushing, defence for offline, woodcutting or mining for gathering.
Curios are an Act 3 system, but their stats apply everywhere.
Each roll shows three curios and you keep one. For the upgrade purchase and value, see Gems 'Fate Spiral'; for opening it each day, see the Daily tab's 'Open the daily Fate Spiral'.
Every roll adds a pity point, and a normal Legendary does not reset them. 100 pity points buy one guaranteed Legendary from the pity chest.
6 ranks, each adding 500 to the cap, cost 450, 550, 650, 750, 850 and 950 gems (4,200 in total). Leave it until the other gem upgrades are bought.
